Feirongda.why: Makes server and data-center thermal products - single-/two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, 3D VC heat sinks, CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and racks, TIM - with AI-server cooling demand and orders rising, so AI-server build-out drives its thermal-management growth.
Feirongda.evidence: Feirongda half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): AI-server cooling demand grew fast and order volume kept rising; its server / data-center cooling products include TIM materials, heat sinks, fans, 3D VC heat sinks, single-/two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, flow controllers, CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and liquid-cooled racks, and many product types are delivered in volume.

players.product: AI-server single- and two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, 3D VC heat sinks, 8kW / 140kW / 600kW CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and racks, TIM thermal materials and fans

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 3,708,784,456.75, up 28.64% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 252,603,244.37, up 52.09%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 260,137,052.22, up 91.30%; operating cash flow RMB 185,013,563.50, down 36.15% (mainly strategic stocking); gross margin 21.66% (up 2.08 points). Inventory rose to RMB 1,424,982,559.66 at June 30, 2026, mainly because sales orders kept growing and stocking increased. The company attributes growth to consumer electronics (higher per-device value and a high share of high-value products despite memory-chip pressure on the industry), communications and new energy.

Segments (half-year report, H1 2026): thermal management materials and devices revenue RMB 1,383,376,608.97, up 27.52%, gross margin 15.08% (down 1.62 points); EMI shielding materials and devices RMB 1,080,469,967.67, up 38.01%, gross margin 31.43% (up 1.61 points); lightweight and other functional devices RMB 896,881,900.20, up 18.07%, gross margin 18.45% (up 6.90 points). Domestic sales RMB 3,115,424,426.00 (up 36.10%); overseas sales RMB 593,360,030.75 (down 0.13%).

AI servers (half-year report): the company says its communications business developed well; AI-server cooling demand grew fast, cooperation with several important customers is progressing in an orderly way, order volume keeps rising, and revenue in this area grew both year on year and quarter on quarter. Its server and data-center cooling products include TIM materials, various heat sinks, fans, 3D VC heat sinks, single-/two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, flow controllers, CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and liquid-cooled racks; many product types are delivered in volume, and sampling and trial production for some high-value-added new projects continue.

R&D (half-year report): the company has self-developed 8kW, 140kW and 600kW CDU products covering edge compute, conventional AI racks and ultra-high-density full racks, and has also worked on ultra-thin (copper-PI-copper) vapor chambers, new-energy liquid-cooling module manufacturing, 6-8W thermal absorbing gel, micro fans and bionic low-noise fans, and dexterous hands; it says some of these projects have achieved results, with related products completing trial production, customer certification and volume delivery. H1 2026 R&D spending RMB 204,847,992.53, up 31.36%; 934 patents held as of June 30, 2026 (222 invention patents).

New energy (half-year report): designated NEV project orders keep being released, driving steady sales growth, and new project designations are progressing; in energy-storage liquid cooling, cooperation with core customers is steady, orders are delivered on demand and the business has achieved staged results.

Customers by segment (half-year report): terminal customers include 'Company H' (as the company names it), Microsoft, Lenovo, Samsung, Honor, Xiaomi, Cowell, HP, Dell, Quanta, Pegatron, Inventec, Huaqin, Baolongda and Daineng; communications customers 'Company H', ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Cisco and CICT Mobile; NEV customers include BYD, GAC, SAIC, CRRC, Geely, Vmax, RoboSense, CATL, LG Energy Solution, CALB, REPT, Sunwoda, Gotion, Pony.ai, BorgWarner and Hesheng; PV and energy-storage customers include 'Company H', YG, Growatt, GoodWe, Sigenergy, TBEA, Inovance, Huabao New Energy, Maitian Energy, Kubo and Shouhang; other customers include Gree, Mindray, Snibe, Panasonic, DJI, Goertek, Quanta, Compal, Pegatron, Pudu, UBTech, Ninebot, Legrand and Dyson.

Construction projects (half-year report, as of June 30, 2026): Jiangsu Feirongda smart power and new materials project (Base B) phase 1 - budget RMB 1,030,504,310.31, progress 42.38%, still under construction; Feirongda new-energy smart manufacturing base project (including the new-energy related devices project) - budget RMB 1,479,590,000.00, progress 99.62%, still under construction; Shenzhen Feirongda communications-module industrialization project - progress 100.00%. The raised-fund new-energy related devices project had RMB 42,586.49 ten-thousand invested of RMB 79,824.37 ten-thousand committed (53.35%), with a scheduled usable date of December 31, 2026. Construction in progress RMB 600,851,976.67.
